title: (LEAD) Seoul stocks open lower as disappointing tech earnings trigger AI spending woes
caption:
A sharp tech pullback on Wall Street quickly rippled across Asian markets this morning. Disappointing quarterly figures from major hardware and cloud giants are forcing investors to reconsider how quickly AI investments will actually translate into profits.
